At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Global Trade Analyst (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Team with third party service providers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and suppliers as necessary to implement and/or maintain customs compliance and logistics processes in support of operations

 * Communicate with Austrian customs office

 * Review root cause and respond to export issues tied to customs data identified during internal audits

 * Document desk procedure

 * Create more efficient ways of recurring tasks with support of available tools and/or AI 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * Completed apprenticeship in Business-Logistics-Apprenticeship or graduate of HAK/HAS would be preferred

 * 2 years of related experience would be preferred

 * Open minded personality

 * Ability and willingness to learn (GIS systems, processes)

 * Communicates clearly and professionally with internal teams and external partners across various forums and meetings.

Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful Quality Engineering Team at our plant in Leoben, we are looking for passionate 1 Junior Customer Quality Our Quality Engineering teams are at the core of ensuring product excellence and customer satisfaction, working in focus areas:

Customer-Focused Quality Assurance - acting as the primary liaison for customer requirements, documentation, audits, and issue resolution.

Production Quality Assurance - monitoring and improving internal processes, ensuring compliance, and driving continuous improvement.

Depending on your strengths, your role may emphasize direct customer interaction or internal quality assurance activities. 

Your Responsibilities 

Customer-Focused Tasks

 * Implement and monitor customer-defined quality requirements in production

 * Prepare and maintain quality documentation (Certificates of Conformance, inspection and reliability specifications) and coordinate customer approvals

 * Organize and support customer audits and visits; ensure smooth communication and execution

 * Review and align internal processes with customer specifications; manage claims and 8D processes 

Production-Focused Tasks

 * Monitor compliance with internal quality standards and initiate corrective actions to prevent nonconformities

 * Support qualification of new materials, equipment, and processes; promote continuous improvement and advanced problem-solving methods

 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, NPI, QE, Laboratory) to standardize quality requirements across all product life stages 

Your Profile 

 * HTL graduate, University degree in e.g. Engineering or equivalent proven experience

 * Strong communication skills in English for the Customer focused role and German language skills for the Production focused role

 * Proficient in Microsoft Office; organized and eager to learn

 * Experience in customer or supplier communication and substrate industry is an advantage 

Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and available e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

jobs.description:
At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. 2 Student Job (f/m/x) - Data & AI Automation (20-25 h/week) 

Join the Non-Financial Risk Tribe at RBI Group. We are expanding the use of data, automation, and AI to improve internal processes and efficiency across the organization.

To support these initiatives, we are looking for a working student with a strong interest in data, automation, and modern technologies. In this role, you will contribute to building automation solutions, supporting data workflows, and experimenting with AI tools in a practical environment.

 

 

At a glance

 * Starting date: as soon as possible

 * Working hours: 20-25 h/week

 * Location: 1030 Vienna

 

Your role with us on the team

 

 * Support the development of automation scripts and small internal tools (e.g. Python-based solutions)

 * Assist in data preparation, transformation, and analysis

 * Contribute to data pipelines and data flows using modern platforms (e.g. Databricks)

 * Help build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for risk purposes

 * Leverage AI/LLM tools to improve efficiency (e.g. automation, documentation, data analysis)

 * Collaborate with team members on small automation and data use cases

 * Gain hands-on experience with modern data platforms and tools

 

Your core competencies

 

 * Ongoing studies in IT, Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field

 * Fluency in English

 * Strong interest in data, automation and modern technologies

 * Basic programming skills (preferably Python)

 * Basic understanding of data handling and structured datasets (SQL is a plus)

 * Interest in risk related methods especially Non-Financial Risk

 * Analytical thinking and structured working style

 * First experience with Power BI, Databricks, APIs, low-code tools or Git is a plus

 

What's in it for you

 

 * Work & Study: The ability to gain practical experience with real world data and automation use cases in an international banking environment while continuing your studies

 * Flexibility: Working hours adaptable to your university schedule and a balance of on-site and home-office days

 * Onboarding: An easy start with a buddy from your team to guide you

 * Community: Internal networking with other students

 * Internationality: Operations in Central and Eastern Europe with English as the corporate language, providing a foundation for an international career

 * Canteen: A wide variety of healthy, tasty, and heavily subsidized meal options

 * Further Benefits: Shopping vouchers from the staff council (e.g., supermarkets), free museum tickets, attractive sports offers, fitness center membership allowance, and a reduced public transport pass

 * Compensation: An attractive monthly student salary of gross EUR 2,619.73 (based on 38.5 hours per week)

Apply now!

Hospitality Agent Front Office

Stellenbeschreibung

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. At The Cloud One Hotels, our goal is to foster an environment where both guests and team members feel comfortable and genuinely welcomed! Your responsibilities include:

- Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Whether you're a professional in the hospitality industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

1 Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems Your mission
Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems 

 * Taking over and owning the on-site Windows service that bridges our medical measurement devices to the platform. It drives around 10 device families via Bluetooth, serial, TCP and file exchange. 
 * Operation, maintenance and further development of the device drivers, the local REST API, the system-tray status UI, firmware updates and the Windows installer. 
 * Building and shipping releases: PyInstaller executable, NSIS installer, Windows Defender/firewall handling, auto-update mechanism and the PT10 ESP32 firmware flasher. 
 * Rolling out releases to the lab sites and troubleshooting problems that occur on-site - including occasional travel to our locations. 
 * Securing and documenting the systems so they can be maintained by more than one person in the long run. 

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Owning the lab operator web app, an Angular / Ionic / Electron application that runs on the lab PC and guides the operator through login, packages, stations, appointments and the checkup flow. 
 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack. 
 * Integrating with the wider Wellabe platform: the Laravel/PHP admin platform for device master data, the Flask backend that handles body-age calculations and reporting, and the Ionic/Capacitor mobile app for user-facing results. 
 * Improving observability: centralised logging, clearer error signals and faster remote diagnosis so that "it didn't work in Munich on Tuesday" becomes solvable from your desk. 
 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile
Must-haves

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends. 
 * Experience with hardware integration - serial interfaces, Bluetooth, TCP; you can read a device protocol and understand what is happening on the wire. 
 * Frontend skills - solid Angular/TypeScript experience and a practical understanding of Ionic/Capacitor or Electron build chains. 
 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite). 
 * Remote debugging from incomplete information - you can reconstruct what happened from logs, screenshots and second-hand descriptions, without being able to reproduce the issue locally. 
 * Willingness to travel to our offices in Munich and Vienna, and enjoyment of working with real devices. 
 * Fluent German - you need to communicate with local teams and support staff at our lab sites in German-speaking countries. 
 * Good English - collaboration in an international team.

Nice-to-haves

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.
